---
description-meta: "Repeat purchase within 30 and 60 days for first-time buyers, by coupon use and acquisition medium."
title: "Repeat purchase"
pagetitle: "Repeat purchase"
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {
  loadResults,
  dataAlert,
  repeatChart,
  dataTable,
  segmentLabel,
  SEGMENT_LABELS,
  formatPercent,
  formatPoints,
  formatCount,
  intervalText,
} from "./charts.js"

results = loadResults({
  cohorts: FileAttachment("sources/results/cohort_repeat_purchase.csv"),
  couponDifference: FileAttachment("sources/results/cohort_coupon_difference.csv"),
  mediumCheck: FileAttachment("sources/results/profile_user_acquisition_consistency.csv"),
})
```

```{ojs}
//| classes: data-alert-slot
dataAlert(results.missing)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cohorts = results.data.cohorts
couponDifference = results.data.couponDifference
overall30 = cohorts.find((row) => row.split === "all" && row.window_days === 30) ?? {}
overall60 = cohorts.find((row) => row.split === "all" && row.window_days === 60) ?? {}
coupon30 = couponDifference.find((row) => row.window_days === 30) ?? {}
mediumCheck = results.data.mediumCheck[0] ?? {}
unstableBuyers = mediumCheck.buyers_with_several_mediums / mediumCheck.buyers
```

::: {.lede}
Coupon buyers came back no less often than other first-time buyers:
${formatPercent(coupon30.coupon_repeat_rate)} against
${formatPercent(coupon30.no_coupon_repeat_rate)} within 30 days. The difference,
${formatPoints(coupon30.difference)} points, has an interval from
${formatPoints(coupon30.difference_low)} to ${formatPoints(coupon30.difference_high)}.
:::

Repeat purchase is low for everyone: ${formatPercent(overall30.repeat_rate)} of
${formatCount(overall30.first_time_buyers)} first-time buyers bought again within 30 days, and
${formatPercent(overall60.repeat_rate)} of ${formatCount(overall60.first_time_buyers)} within 60
days. A first-time buyer was first seen inside the export; a repeat is a purchase on a later day.
A buyer counts toward a window only if the whole window fits before 31 January 2021, so the 60-day
rate rests on November buyers only.

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-repeat
repeatChart(Plot, cohorts, {
  width,
  windowDays: 30,
  title: `Coupon buyers repeat at ${formatPercent(coupon30.coupon_repeat_rate)} within 30 days; no segment differs clearly from the ${formatPercent(overall30.repeat_rate)} average`,
  subtitle: "Share of first-time buyers who bought again within 30 days, with 95% Wilson intervals. First purchases 1 Nov 2020 to 1 Jan 2021.",
})
```

The medium split is weaker than the coupon split. GA4 defines the medium as the user's first
touch, which should never change, yet ${formatPercent(unstableBuyers)} of buyers carry more than
one. Each buyer's medium here is the one on their earliest event.

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
segmentRows = cohorts.length === 0 ? [] : [...SEGMENT_LABELS.keys()]
  .filter((segment) => cohorts.some((row) => row.segment === segment))
  .map((segment) => ({
    label: segmentLabel(segment),
    days30: cohorts.find((row) => row.segment === segment && row.window_days === 30) ?? {},
    days60: cohorts.find((row) => row.segment === segment && row.window_days === 60) ?? {},
  }))

dataTable({
  caption: "Repeat purchase by segment, with 95% Wilson intervals",
  rows: segmentRows,
  columns: [
    { label: "Segment", value: (row) => row.label },
    { label: "Buyers, 30 days", value: (row) => formatCount(row.days30.first_time_buyers), numeric: true },
    { label: "Repeat, 30 days", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.days30.repeat_rate), numeric: true },
    {
      label: "30-day interval",
      value: (row) => intervalText(row.days30.repeat_rate_low, row.days30.repeat_rate_high),
      numeric: true,
    },
    { label: "Buyers, 60 days", value: (row) => formatCount(row.days60.first_time_buyers), numeric: true },
    { label: "Repeat, 60 days", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.days60.repeat_rate), numeric: true },
    {
      label: "60-day interval",
      value: (row) => intervalText(row.days60.repeat_rate_low, row.days60.repeat_rate_high),
      numeric: true,
    },
  ],
})
```

```{ojs}
//| classes: slot-table
dataTable({
  caption: "Coupon minus no coupon, repeat purchase in percentage points",
  rows: couponDifference,
  columns: [
    { label: "Window", value: (row) => `${row.window_days} days` },
    { label: "Coupon", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.coupon_repeat_rate), numeric: true },
    { label: "No coupon", value: (row) => formatPercent(row.no_coupon_repeat_rate), numeric: true },
    { label: "Difference", value: (row) => formatPoints(row.difference), numeric: true },
    {
      label: "95% interval",
      value: (row) => `${formatPoints(row.difference_low)} to ${formatPoints(row.difference_high)}`,
      numeric: true,
    },
  ],
})
```
